messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: P1 - org 'borealis' QPS spike exceeding org quota. Triggered at 2025-11-09T02:10:32Z. Paging rotation: maya -> sam. Details: spike from 120 qps to 980 qps sustained for 3m. api gateway 503s rising.
Maya (oncall): acked. I'm on it, pulling metrics now.
Maya (oncall): Sam can you stand by for a quick per-org throttle override? Need emergency mitigation while we investigate root cause.
Sam (eng-sre): On it. If we can apply a temporary rate cap for borealis at the gateway layer, we should stop downstream 503 cascades. Suggest 250 qps as a short-term cap.
Oliver (support): FYI Borealis saying some internal jobs kicked off unexpectedly; customer contact is inbound. I'll loop Nora.
Nora (acct-exec): I'm on the line with their ops lead, telling them we're applying temporary controls and will follow up with postmortem. Please let me know exact window.
Sam (eng-sre): I'm going to push an org override via internal admin API. Command:
```
# apply org override - set soft_qps to 250 for org id 0xB0A
curl -s -X POST https://admin.internal.api/orgs/0xB0A/overrides -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -d '{"soft_qps":250, "expires_in_s":900, "reason":"emergency spike mitigation"}'
```
Sam (eng-sre): Doing it now.
support-bot: admin-api: override request received, job id v-90821 queued.
Sam (eng-sre): override job completed. Gateway shows rule applied: borealis -> soft_qps 250.
Maya (oncall): seeing immediate drop in 5xxs at downstream services. Token throughput reduced. Nice. 
Liam (infra): Noted that autoscaler still trying to spin more nodes due to connection churn; I'll pause scale-up for this org to avoid flapping. Command I'll run:
```
# pause autoscale for org
kubectl annotate deployment gateway-borealis scale.k8s.redwood/pause=true --namespace infra-orgs
```
Liam (infra): done.
Oliver (support): Borealis ops: "Thanks — that helped. We had a runaway churn job. We'll pause it." They asked for expected duration.
Nora (acct-exec): Told them 15 minutes while we run diagnostics and confirm stability. I'll send a follow-up note with the override details and expiry.
Sam (eng-sre): Running a quick check on token bucket fills and prefix cache pressure. No KV cache evictions attributable to this org after the cap. Metrics: request rate for borealis now ~240 qps, error rate back to baseline.
Maya (oncall): Good. What's next on root cause? Oliver, can you confirm which customer job was runaway?
Oliver (support): They're investigating. Their team identified a cron that misfired across prod jobs after a recent deploy. Sounds internal to them.
Sam (eng-sre): I'm going to leave the override in place 15 minutes (expires at +900s) and prepare a manual rollback command in case we need more time. Manual extend:
```
curl -s -X PATCH https://admin.internal.api/orgs/0xB0A/overrides/v-90821 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' -d '{"expires_in_s":1800}'
```
Maya (oncall): fine. If their traffic returns to normal earlier we remove it. Also create an event in the incident timeline.
Sam (eng-sre): Added incident note: emergency org-cap override applied at 2025-11-09T02:12:10Z, soft_qps 250, expires +900s job v-90821.
incident-bot: Incident channel created: #inc-borealis-1968765432. PagerDuty: acknowledged.
Oliver (support): Customer confirmed they killed the cron. Asking whether you can lift the cap now.
Sam (eng-sre): I'll check signal for 3 consecutive 30s windows of stable low error rate before lifting.
Maya (oncall): Metrics look stable for the last 2 windows, one more and we can lift.
Sam (eng-sre): Lifting override now.
support-bot: override v-90821 revoked by Sam (eng-sre) at 2025-11-09T02:20:25Z.
Sam (eng-sre): revoke command:
```
curl -X DELETE https://admin.internal.api/orgs/0xB0A/overrides/v-90821 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'
```
Sam (eng-sre): gateway rules removed. Observability: request rates for borealis back to customer baseline ~95 qps, no downstream 5xx spike.
Maya (oncall): Great. I'll close the pager once we have final confirmation and add remediation/action items.
Nora (acct-exec): I've emailed the customer with a short summary and told them we'll send a detailed postmortem. They appreciated the heads up.
Maya (oncall): Post-incident tasks: 1) Add org-level early-detection rule for sudden >5x QPS within 5m. 2) Create runbook snippet for per-org override flow (curl commands, who to notify). 3) Review gating for autoscaler pause on org overrides. Sam/Liam/Oliver take.
Sam (eng-sre): I'll own the runbook and the automation for safe-override (require two approvals for extends beyond 30m).
Liam (infra): I'll add guards to the autoscaler to respect the pause annotation.
Oliver (support): I'll coordinate the customer postmortem and include timeline + mitigation notes.
Maya (oncall): Closing incident in 10m if no regressions. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
support-bot: Incident closed (auto) at 2025-11-09T02:29:60Z.
Maya (oncall): Actually small nit: timestamps above in logs show 02:29:60, that's nonstandard ;). All good, documented.
